text: FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復 FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復 v_t=D\Delta v+v-v^3/3-w+I w_t=\epsilon(v+a-bw) 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。 FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery v_t=D\Delta v+v-v^3/3-w+I w_t=\epsilon(v+a-bw) A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE.
